payload.note: Finding 3 (.env.local resolved from cwd) fixed. Fix: src/llm/config.ts derives DEFAULT_ENV_FILE_PATH by walking up from import.meta.dir to the directory containing package.json and resolving .env.local there, replacing resolve(process.cwd(), ENV_FILE_NAME). New POE_ENV_FILE (ENV_FILE_ENV) is the explicit override, below an explicit envFilePath option and above the default; the missing-key LlmConfigError now names the resolved path and the override variable. Tests: tests/llm/config.test.ts gains a real child process spawned with cwd set to an mkdtemp holding a decoy .env.local (decoy key plus POE_BASE_URL https://decoy.example/v1) — the child reports booleans only, never the key, and proves the decoy was not read, the base URL is the default rather than the decoy's, and the repo's own file was the one read; plus a package-root path assertion, a POE_ENV_FILE override case, an option-wins-over-variable case, and an error-names-the-path case. tests/ui/cli.test.ts and tests/e2e/game.test.ts relied on an empty cwd to be keyless — that no longer works, so both now pass POE_ENV_FILE at a nonexistent file; the cli test 'without a key the game still starts' still passes and the e2e offline spawns remain --no-llm, which constructs no client at all.
